method: Agent read final summaries and all findings against the pre-model inspected PNGs and synthetic constructions. This is not human-gold adjudication.

bar_pairing_defect.reason: Both identify Nozzle A 26 instead of 9 and C 9 instead of 26.

line_unit_defect.reason: Both identify the visible psi Y title instead of the required kPa title/unit.

grouped_legend_defect.reason: Both correctly identify reversed Aster/Beryl value pairing. Baseline cites Trial 1; candidate cites both trials.

table_missing_row_defect.reason: Both name the absent Cobalt 0.86 row, which is missing from the complete PNG.

indicator_value_defect.reason: Both identify the displayed 880 instead of the source value 88.

limitations: Small clear English synthetic images with full reference coverage, not a broad benchmark.
One trial per image/runtime; provider/cache/contention differences were not isolated.
No runtime or prompt was changed after the freeze; no failed trial was rerun.
